thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Increased authentication failures (401) and elevated token-service latency observed globally. Impacting hosted API and Dedicated control-plane. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1860054321

oncall-ravi: I'm the incident lead. Triage started - checking token-service, token-db latency, and recent deploys. @auth-maya please join.

auth-maya: joining. Seeing token-db write p95 > 2s and token-cache miss rate spiking. A recent cache-config change (ttl reduced) rolled at 02:10Z might be amplifying write load.

infra-lucy: scaling token-db replicas from 3 -> 6 and adding IOPS to volumes now. Command: `aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier token-db --iops 8000` (in progress).

auth-maya: reverting cache-config to previous ttl (30m) to reduce backend writes. Patching config and triggering rolling restart of auth-service.

support-joe: publishing initial customer message & linking status: "We're investigating increased auth failures. Mitigations in progress. Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1860054321"

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: cache-config rollback applied; token-db replicas increased; observed 401 rate drop from ~9% -> ~1.2% in 4m. Continuing to monitor.

oncall-ravi: temporary measures: throttling token-issuance for non-interactive clients to reduce load (clients with client_type=batch). Notifying account teams.

product-sam: notified enterprise customers and approving credits for impacted usage windows. Preparing FAQ for CS.

auth-maya: collecting token-service traces and heap dumps. Will capture root cause timeline. Avoiding further config changes until RCA.

infra-lucy: verifying replication sync and IOPS change completion. If stable, we'll scale down to 4 replicas overnight.

oncall-ravi: postmortem owners: @auth-maya (root cause + fix), @infra-lucy (db scaling & resilience), @product-sam (customer comms). ETA initial RCA: EOD.

incidents-bot: STATE: mitigated -> recovering. Public status updated. Next update in 30m or earlier if regression. Thread limited to incident leads.

support-joe: all customer-facing tickets updated and labeled INCIDENT-1860054321.

incidents-bot: FINAL UPDATE: 1860054681 - Token-service latency returned to baseline; 401s near zero. Rotation of cache-config postponed until fix validated. Incident resolved; postmortem scheduled.
